description: Fetch paginated search results with rate-limit-aware batching (max 1000/page, 50 pages, 50000 records total). Default mode returns one page. Use aggregate for ID counts/sums without full rows. Use file mode to stream JSONL or CSV locally — never for bulk mirroring of Dimensions data. Entities: publications, grants, researchers, patents, clinical_trials, datasets, policy_documents, organizations, reports, source_titles, funder_groups, research_org_groups.

confirmLargeFetch.description: Required when maxPages > 5 or planned records > 5000. Acknowledges reasonable-use policy.

entityType.description: Dimensions source to search (same as search_* tools)

fields.description: Fields to return. Accepts aliases or DSL names. id is always included; publications also always include doi. Use dimensions://fields/{entity} for the full list.

filingYearFrom.description: Filter patents filed from this year (inclusive)

filingYearTo.description: Filter patents filed up to this year (inclusive)

filters.description: Additional where-clause filters. Each item needs field, operator, and (except for is_empty/is_not_empty) value, e.g. {"field": "researchers.id", "operator": "=", "value": "ur.01343614074.49"}. Supported operators: =, !=, >, <, >=, <=, in, is_empty, is_not_empty.

funderOrgName.description: Filter by funder organization name. Acronyms NCI, NSF, NEH resolve automatically; use facet_query/aggregate_query on funder_orgs to discover exact names.

maxPages.description: Pages to fetch in aggregate/file modes (default 1, max 50). Ignored in page mode.

maxRecords.description: Stop after this many records across pages

mode.description: page: return one page in the tool response; aggregate: fetch multiple pages and return summary only; file: stream JSONL or CSV to outputPath (not returned in chat)

outputFormat.description: File format for file mode (default: infer from outputPath extension, else JSONL)

outputPath.description: Required for file mode — local output path (.jsonl or .csv)

page.description: Page index (0-based). Equivalent to skip = page × limit. Max page 49.

pageSize.description: Records per page (page mode default 100, aggregate/file default 1000; max 1000)

query.description: Free-text search terms. Optional — omit for a filters-only search that relies solely on `filters` and/or the entity-specific convenience filters (e.g. yearFrom/yearTo).

resumeFromMeta.description: Resume file export from existing outputPath.meta.json sidecar

skip.description: Records to skip (0-based). Mutually exclusive with page. Max window: 50000 total records.

startPage.description: Starting page for aggregate/file modes (0-based, default 0)

startYearFrom.description: Filter grants starting from this year (inclusive)

startYearTo.description: Filter grants starting up to this year (inclusive)

yearTo.description: Filter reports up to this year (inclusive)

name: fetch_search_pages

largeResultWarning.description: Soft warning when totalCount exceeds 10,000 — narrow filters first

pagination.description: Pagination metadata when results span multiple pages

policyNotice.description: Reasonable-use reminder when results are truncated or very large

title: Fetch more results
